title: Advanced Paste: Paste with AI can't find Foundry Local models
author: jacktose
summary: Foundry Local 0.10.3 is healthy with loaded models, but PowerToys pins the CLI-dependent 0.3.0 SDK and reports an empty model list.

status.label: Design ready for approval
status.detail: The converged design migrates the incompatible legacy Foundry SDK and separates discovery failure from a genuine empty cache.

next_action.label: Approve Foundry Local SDK migration design
next_action.reason: The corrected design is implementation-ready and is captured in the fork mirror issue.

judgment.rationale: The report is a reproducible Advanced Paste integration defect. Foundry Local 0.10.3 works through its CLI, while PowerToys uses the CLI-dependent 0.3.0 SDK; current code then swallows discovery errors as an empty model list.
evidence: The report shows Foundry Local 0.10.3 Ready, a localhost URL, phi-4-mini loaded, two cached models, and successful CLI chat.
The supplied diagnostic archive was rejected as invalid and its settings log is empty; no diagnostic log claim is treated as observed.
Official Foundry documentation classifies C# 0.3.0 and earlier as CLI-dependent legacy SDK versions and documents the current manager/catalog/IModel API.
FoundryClient.ListCatalogModels swallows exceptions and ListCachedModels returns [] on any exception; AdvancedPastePage renders that as no local models.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve the fork-side SDK migration and discovery-error handling design.

fix_assessment.rationale: No linked or fork implementation fixes this 0.10.3 discovery incompatibility; the fork mirror is design-only.

proposed_fixes.title: Migrate Advanced Paste to the current Foundry Local SDK and preserve discovery errors
proposed_fixes.root_cause: PowerToys pins the CLI-dependent Microsoft.AI.Foundry.Local 0.3.0 SDK. Foundry Local 0.10.3 uses the newer architecture, leaving legacy endpoint/listing calls unusable; the wrapper converts the failure to an empty list and the UI reports no models.
plan: Pin the current Windows-compatible Foundry SDK and update LanguageModelProvider to its manager/catalog/IModel lifecycle.
Replace legacy service-URI/listing/loading calls with current catalog, cached/loaded model, and model chat-client operations behind an internal adapter.
Propagate typed discovery failures and show a localized available-but-discovery-failed state; reserve no-model guidance for a successful empty cache.
Add fake-based provider and Settings regression tests, then build the affected projects.
verification: With Foundry Local 0.10.3 healthy and a loaded model, refresh Advanced Paste and verify the model is selectable.
If discovery cannot recover, verify Settings shows a discovery-error state rather than no-model guidance.
Verify a genuinely successful empty cached-model response still shows the existing empty state.

confidence.rationale: The package version boundary, public SDK documentation, report architecture details, and current swallowed-error/UI path directly agree; only exact package overloads need compile-time confirmation.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste cannot enumerate cached Foundry Local models from a functioning Foundry Local 0.10.3 installation.
known_information: The reporter loaded phi-4-mini and successfully used Foundry CLI chat.
Foundry Local reports Ready with a localhost web URL and cached/loaded models.
PowerToys 0.101.2362 shows no downloaded models after refreshes and restarts.
The supplied archive is structurally invalid for log analysis; its settings log is empty.
No assignee or concrete fix is present in the issue discussion.
inferences: The discovery failure is caused by the legacy SDK contract being incompatible with Foundry Local 0.10.3.
The false empty state is caused by FoundryClient swallowing listing exceptions.
issue_context.analysis: The archive cannot substantiate a log-level URI message, but the package pin, official legacy/current SDK boundary, reported 0.10.3 architecture, and source control flow are sufficient for a high-confidence design. The implementation must compile against and validate the selected current Windows package.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue, comments, timeline, screenshot/report attachment, and related historical issue context.
Inspected FoundryClient, FoundryLocalModelProvider, AdvancedPastePage, DTOs, package references, and Foundry integration history.
Reviewed current and legacy public Foundry SDK documentation and current C# SDK source APIs.
Updated existing fork mirror issue 583 rather than creating a duplicate.
information_gaps: Exact current Windows package version and target-framework-compatible overloads must be confirmed during implementation.
The minimum supported Foundry Local version after migration must be chosen and documented.

design.root_cause: PowerToys uses Microsoft.AI.Foundry.Local 0.3.0, a CLI-dependent legacy SDK. Foundry Local 0.10.3 is the newer architecture, so the legacy manager can exist while its endpoint/model-list requests fail. FoundryClient.ListCatalogModels and ListCachedModels swallow those failures, and AdvancedPastePage.ShowFoundryAvailableState renders the resulting empty collection as no downloaded models.
evidence: Observed: issue report shows Foundry Local 0.10.3 Ready, localhost service URL, phi-4-mini loaded, two cached models, and successful CLI chat.
Observed: supplied archive was rejected as invalid; log_settings.json is empty.
Observed: public legacy SDK documentation classifies 0.3.0 and earlier as CLI-dependent; current SDK uses CreateAsync, GetCatalogAsync, ICatalog, and IModel.
Observed: FoundryClient catches catalog errors and returns an empty cached list on listing errors.
Observed: AdvancedPastePage shows the no-model text whenever its cached collection is empty.
Inferred: incompatible SDK plus swallowed errors produces the reported false empty state.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The project pins and references the CLI-dependent 0.3.0 package.
implementation_steps.change: Pin the current Windows-compatible Foundry SDK package/version validated against the existing target framework, preferring the supported WinML package on Windows, and update the project reference.
edge_cases: Confirm x64/ARM64 native assets and minimum supported Foundry Local version.
Do not retain assumptions about legacy constructors or endpoint properties.
tests: Restore and build the common provider project for supported platforms.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The wrapper constructs the legacy manager and converts all listing failures into cached/empty results.
implementation_steps.change: Initialize the current manager through its Configuration/AppName/logger CreateAsync contract, obtain ICatalog, use ListModelsAsync/GetCachedModelsAsync/GetLoadedModelsAsync, map IModel.Info, and preserve initialization/listing failures as typed errors.
implementation_steps.code_block: await FoundryLocalManager.CreateAsync(configuration, logger, ct);`nvar manager = FoundryLocalManager.Instance;`nvar catalog = await manager.GetCatalogAsync(ct);`nvar models = await catalog.ListModelsAsync(ct);`nvar cached = await catalog.GetCachedModelsAsync(ct);`nvar loaded = await catalog.GetLoadedModelsAsync(ct);
edge_cases: Use IModel.LoadAsync/IsLoadedAsync and the current model chat-client path.
Keep PATH refresh only if the selected package still needs it.
Never return empty success for an SDK failure.
tests: Fake adapter tests for successful, empty, initialization-failure, and listing-failure paths.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Provider maps legacy DTOs and constructs OpenAI from a legacy service URI.
implementation_steps.change: Map current IModel/ModelInfo aliases and IDs to the existing fl:// ModelDetails contract; load and obtain the current SDK chat client, or explicitly configure the SDK web service only if required by the selected package.
implementation_steps.code_block: var model = await _foundryClient.GetModelAsync(modelId, ct);`nawait model.LoadAsync(ct);`nvar sdkClient = await model.GetChatClientAsync(ct);`nreturn sdkClient.AsIChatClient();
edge_cases: Preserve aliases/concrete IDs and cached-model self-healing.
Keep cancellation and meaningful refresh behavior.
tests: Verify cached model mapping, load checks, chat-client creation, and discovery exception propagation.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Swallowed discovery failures arrive as zero models and render the genuine empty-cache message.
implementation_steps.change: Catch typed discovery errors separately, keep service availability distinct, show localized actionable error text, and reserve no-model guidance for successful empty results.
implementation_steps.code_block: catch (FoundryLocalDiscoveryException ex) { Logger.LogError("Foundry Local model discovery failed", ex); DispatcherQueue.TryEnqueue(ShowFoundryDiscoveryError); }
edge_cases: Keep Save disabled without a selection and preserve cancellation.
tests: Discovery failure shows error state; successful empty list shows no-model state; non-empty list enables selection.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: No tests cover the legacy/current SDK boundary or swallowed discovery state.
implementation_steps.change: Add deterministic fake-based regression tests and run the narrowest existing builds/tests for affected projects.
tests: Run existing targeted unit tests and builds for LanguageModelProvider, Settings.UI.UnitTests, PowerToys.Settings, and AdvancedPaste as applicable.

verify: Reproduce with Foundry Local 0.10.3, phi-4-mini loaded, status Ready, CLI chat successful, and the pre-fix false empty picker.
Install fixed binaries and refresh the Foundry Local picker; phi-4-mini must be selectable.
Save the model and run Paste with AI on a small selection; expect a response.
Verify successful empty cache and injected discovery failure render distinct messages.
Run targeted existing tests and builds.
risks: SDK migration changes initialization, native assets, model IDs, lifetime, and inference integration; mitigate with an adapter and x64/ARM64 builds.
Older CLI-dependent Foundry versions may no longer be supported; document the minimum supported version.
Current SDK chat-client and optional web-service APIs must be validated against the pinned package.
alternatives: Direct REST fallback on the legacy manager was rejected because the package contract is itself incompatible and exact 0.10.3 routes are not established.
UI-only wording change was rejected because models would remain unusable.
Another diagnostic request was not required for design because the archive failure is known and source/package/history evidence identifies the mismatch.
